2,236 of 133,102 listings (1.7%) carry Amazon's Best Seller badge.
Kindle Unlimited books carry the badge 5.2× as often as other books (4.1% vs 0.8%), and the gap holds in 31 of 31 categories.
Nonfiction has the highest badge rate (5.3%); LGBTQ+ eBooks the lowest (0.3%).
Among price bands, Under $3 has the highest badge rate (4.8%); the median listing costs $9.99.
Where review counts were recorded, bestsellers have a median of 514 reviews vs 301 for other books.
Ratings barely separate books: the average listing scores 4.51 stars.
Review counts are missing for most books in 15 of 31 categories (a scraping gap), so review figures use recorded counts only.
The model's top 1% of listings are bestsellers 20.8% of the time, 12× the 1.7% base rate.
